scope: Automatic observations for a development pilot, not a final report or external product benchmark.
repeatability: One run per case/configuration. Stability and run-to-run variance are not assessed.
comparison: B2 and B3 reuse identical seeded B1 candidates plus externally frozen development analysis, admission and initial execution. Only diagnosis and its downstream repair decision differ; controlled admission establishes the challenge precondition and does not measure natural admission accuracy.
constraints: Development cases are not held out.
Reference witnesses cover specified examples, not all possible inputs.
No independent semantic or diagnosis labels are available.
Model alias, API time drift and caching are not frozen.
More tests or higher pass counts do not establish higher requirement coverage.
nextDecision: Inspect every blocked proposal, reference disagreement and unresolved probe before choosing a larger repeated experiment. Do not tune on a future held-out case set.
